title: Low Cell Input Nuclei Isolation for Single Cell ATAC-Seq
author: Carmen Sancho
materials: Keep buffer A on ice and prepare fresh!
Keep wash buffer on ice and prepare fresh!
Keep lysis buffer on ice and prepare fresh!

steps.title: Prepare cell suspension
steps.instruction: Prepare a cell suspension of 2,000-100,000 cells in PBS + 0.04% BSA.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cell suspension at 300 rcf for 5 min at 4 °C.
Re-suspend the cell pellet in 50 µL of PBS 0.04% BSA.
Transfer 50 µL of the cell suspension to a 0.2 mL tube.

steps.title: Lyse cells to isolate nuclei
steps.instruction: Lysis of cells to release nuclei using chilled Lysis Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 300 rcf for 5 min at 4 °C.
Remove 45 µL of supernatant carefully to avoid dislodging the cell pellet.
Add 45 µL chilled Lysis Buffer and gently pipette mix 3 times.
Incubate on ice for 4 min (range 3-5 min depending on cell type).

steps.title: Wash nuclei
steps.instruction: Wash the isolated nuclei using chilled Wash Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL chilled Wash Buffer to the tube without mixing.
Centrifuge at 500 rcf for 5 min at 4 °C.
Remove 95 µL of supernatant without disrupting the nuclei pellet.

steps.title: Determine nuclei count
steps.instruction: Quantify the nuclei concentration using Trypan blue.

substeps.instruction: Mix 2.5 µL nuclei suspension with 2.5 µL Diluted Nuclei Buffer and 5 µL Trypan blue.
Calculate nuclei count using the formula: nuclei count = _____ x 2 x 2 x 10 nuclei/µL.

steps.title: Final nuclei purification
steps.instruction: Perform final wash and resuspension of nuclei in Diluted Nuclei Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 45 µL chilled Diluted Nuclei Buffer to the pellet without mixing.
Centrifuge at 500 rcf for 5 min at 4 °C.
Remove the supernatant in two steps without touching the bottom of the tube.
Resuspend the nuclei pellet (which may not be visible) in 5.5 µL chilled diluted nuclei buffer.

steps.title: Proceed to transposition
steps.instruction: Prepare the nuclei for the transposition step and GEMS generation.

substeps.instruction: Load approximately 5 µL of nuclei suspension for the transposition step.
Follow the Chromium Single Cell ATAC Solution User Guide (PAGE 24, CG000168_ChromiumSingleCell_ATAC_ReagentKits_UserGuide_RevC.pdf) for GEMS generation.
